Hadien ter ter lah ban tern pynmih sur na ka Duitara ha ka rukom sur tynrai (Traditional) sur paidbah (Popular tunes), sur kyllain (Semi Classical), Sur jyrthiaw (Classical) ba ka Duitara kaba long ka Syiem jong ki ‘Tiar jingtem Khasi” kan shongkhet ha ka rynsan ba dei biang. Nga da sngewdei hok ban ai khublei shikit iapar da shisha shisha ia ki baroh. “U bakhor sngem haba buh hajan ding u kem ding” U Bah Binester Lyngdoh, Ex. Secretary Singing Committee, Sheila Presbytery. U Bah E. Weston Dkhar (Rtd) Deputy Station Director (NES) All India Radio, Shillong.

Pascal Malngiang, Lecturer, Political Science, North Eastern Hills University. U Bah llustrious Mark Syiem, Piano Instructor Institute of Art and Culture, Meghalaya. U Bah Romestar Sohlang, Choir Master, Institute of Art and Culture, Meghalaya. U Bah L. Gilbert Shullai (BKHDUB) Shillong Record Collection Centre, Ralanda, Lumbasuk, Nongthymmai, Shillong. Khamtam eh ia I Kmie ki khun I Kong Noril Risaw lem bad ki khun de baroh, ka Jurimon Risaw, ka Wanaibon Risaw, ka Daprupa Risaw, u Sanjarawaifl Risaw, Idba pisa kiba lynga, kiba duh thiah kiba duh dem haba nga dumt ia ka phang ka rwai ka siaw ka put ka tern kaba shu ioh jalia jalait ubaimeng.

QD SPANG Ha ki Exercises ba la thoh ter ter ha kane ka kot jinghikai tern Duitara, man kawei pat kawei ka lynnong dei ban sdang ban tern nyngkong eh da kaba tern suki kat ban sngew ban biang ki shympriah kti ban buh halor ki ksai ka Duitara ba uwei pa uwei u Note un mih shai kdar ka sur kat banbiang sbiak sbiak. Nangta sa tern kham stet. Shuh shuh nang kham stet shuh shuh, shuh shuh nangtem kliiun stet. Shuh, shuh shuh nangtem stet shisha haduh ba ki shympriahkti kin da khih shaneng shanim kum ki shympriahkti ba par u dkhiew. Ban mang ia ka jingtem stet na kawei sha kawei pat ka jingkham stet ter ter, dci ban buh da thcw ia ka jingstet ba la buh ryntih ha u Metronome Settings la ha ka Largo, Larghetto, Adagio, Andante, Moderate, Allegro, Presto bad Prestissimo. Kajingpynmih iaki sur kyriiah kadei kajingpynmlien ban tern da kynthah la ki sympriahkti.

Kajingpynmih ia ki sur ud ka wan mih na kajingpynmlien ban tern da syllud ia ki shympriahkti la shaneng ne sharum jong u ksai Duitara halor Jong uwei u note ban pynmih ka jingkynud ba iaibtcng ia uwei ne artylli ki sur bteng-kynud katba sngewmon ban pynmih ia ka sur ud. Naduh ka lynnong (Exercise) Part 11, bad ki lynnong ba bud ter ter la buh ban tern da kaba bynta ia ki notes ban tern ha ki pulses (ki tied) jong ki aih ba la buh da ka Tonic Solfa Notation. Namar kata ki nongtem ki dei ban nang ia ki rules (aih) jong ka Tonic Solfa Notation. Ban ioh bud pynsnah ia ka rukom tern sur khasi ha ka Tonic Solfa Notation, ka don sa kawei de ka kot jinghikai ba la thoh bad ba la pynmih madan kaba la ai kyrteng “Ka Persara ki Sur Khasi ha ka Tonic Solfa Notation.” la kane ka kot hikai sur lah ban ioh na dukan 1 .
